title: AHAWR Development Roadmap
subtitle: Agentic Hub for Automation Workflow Routing · 2026 – 2027
lead: AHAWR runs long coding missions on local and cloud models: an Architect plans, a Worker implements, a Reviewer scores, and n8n drives the loop. This roadmap lists the milestones from the first workflows to version 1.0.
note: The plan follows the mission queue (data-tables/ops/real_queue.sh) and the changelog. Dates are start dates of the work; the order of the next missions can change when a mission fails or a decision is made. Hardware tuning of the llama.cpp fork is tracked in its own repository.

hero.title: Mission Board Is Live
hero.tag: Queue, task cards and plan editing on the dashboard — next release 0.6.0
hero.text: The board shows every mission with its tasks, attempts, time, tokens and cost, moves missions in the queue and edits the plan through guarded routes. Board views, i18n and the guards that watch the runner are being built now.

phases.d: n8n + Hermes, Data Tables, prompts and missions
items: First n8n and Hermes workflows (AHAWR, Run Manager)
Data Tables for config, prompts and missions

phases.d: One runner API for Claude Code and the local model
items: claude-runner runs the Claude Code CLI headless behind /v1/runs
LiteLLM between Claude Code and the local llama.cpp
Retrieval service for the Worker and the Reviewer
Thinking policy, compaction and retry tuning
Telegram notices and a control bot
Dashboard with live runs, cost and cache
Prefill and speed missions on llama.cpp
Model benchmark: cloud and local Workers

phases.d: A stable store and per-request thinking control
items: n8n database moved from SQLite to Postgres 16
Thinking switched without a llama restart
Telegram task notice split into several messages
Worker scratch folder survives container recreation

phases.d: Clickable filter values and full-text search over runs
items: Every value of a run is a click-filter, combined with AND/OR
Filter persisted in the URL hash
Run-list fixes and the version rule

phases.d: The queue and the missions as cards
items: Five groups of cards with statistics
Board statistics over HTTP, no wait for the retrieval sync
Run page scroll and polling fixes

phases.d: Everything the first board mission left open
phases.next: NEXT: board views part 1 (6 of 18 tasks)
items: Operations control: process control, loop protection (ops-control)
Task cards, plan editing, thinking panel, readiness and history (board-ui2)
Board views part 1: summary route, project rules, i18n tables (Haiku 5.5)
Board views part 2: smart task ordering, Lanes and Sprint views
Roadmap page (GitHub Pages), ROADMAP.md and the new README (0.5.200 – 0.5.300)

phases.d: Guards, adaptive split and the executor settings
items: ahawr-guards-in-dashboard: all watchers inside the dashboard container
ahawr-cloud-thinking-control: thinking policy for cloud Workers
ahawr-worker-attempt-chain: provider and model per attempt as a setting
ahawr-improvements-v1 / v2: Reviewer calibration, MCP search, nightly Worker suite
ahawr-adaptive-split: plan size gate and automatic split
ahawr-rag-quality: offline evaluation and lexical precision
Dashboard over the local network and on mobile

phases.d: Codex next to Claude Code behind one runner API
items: ahawr-codex-executor: the OpenAI Codex CLI as an engine of a provider block
DeepSeek Harness evaluated as a third executor
Stable provider-block configuration and event format

phases.d: Several missions at once and Hermes parity
items: ahawr-parallel-missions: one workflow, per-mission model and folder
Hermes runs on par with Claude Code on the dashboard
Mission templates and A/B of executors

open: Haiku 5.5 vs local Qwen: first attempt on Haiku, retries on the local model is running on the board missions; a full A/B is on hold.
RAG precision stays at 8.6%: the quality mission is queued.
Executors for 1.0: Codex first; DeepSeek Harness is evaluated before it becomes an engine of a provider block.
